notes: Two isnads for one saying: the first ends at «والأعرج» with no Companion, the second («وحدثنا إسماعيل») runs to «أن أبا هريرة، قال». The Companion written once after the second isnad is read as the shared tail for both (rule 3).
«حدثني أخي» is a bare relation (rule 7). «أن أبا هريرة، قال» names the source the two co-transmitters got the saying from (rule 5).
